why: Same content. B's TV/Tφ/τB/TO/TC are the project's tangentChartSet/tangentChartMap/instance/retractTangent/tangentSet, and B's chart (TV, Tφ, (TO,TC,TE)) is tangentChart hφ α₀ (when TX is empty, TV and TO are both empty).
